name: Hulk (Immortal)

abilityDetails.Suppression: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Petrify: Düşmanın iyileşme ve güç kazanım hızını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Tek tehlike ilk canın sonunda gelen devasa iyileşme. Petrify ve iyileşme-azaltmaya immün — iyileşme engeli veya savunma yeteneği azaltan şampiyon kullan.
signatureAbility:
The Green Door
Hulk surges with gamma energy from the Below-Place, gaining benefits while above certain thresholds of Gamma Radiation:
25%: Basic Attacks have a [2 - 5]% chance to inflict a Stun Debuff, lasting 0.75 second(s).
50%: When the Opponent is Immune to a Stun Effect or a Stun Effect expires, inflict a Weakness Debuff, decreasing Attack Rating by [25 - 45]% for 4 second(s).
75%: Inflict an indefinite Petrify Debuff of [25 - 7]5% Potency.
immunityDetails:
• Zehir Bağışıklığı 🧪
• İyileşme Tersine Çevirmeye dirençli 💚🔄❌
• Kontrolleri Tersine Çevirme Bağışıklığı (Supervisor ile sinerji) 🧠

abilitySections.title: Gamma Mutate - Always Active
content: An enhanced immune system provides full immunity to the Poisons of the Battlerealm.
Hulk's Regeneration Rate cannot be decreased or increased by outside sources.
Gain up to [10,657] Attack Rating based on how much health Hulk has lost during the entire fight. This ability is based on 200% of Hulk's Health.

abilitySections.title: RAGE - Max 25 Stacks
content: Hulk's Medium Attacks, the first hit of his Special 1 Attack and the first and last hits of his Special 2 Attack apply a RAGE stack.
Consecutive RAGE Attacks build up RAGE stacks. All RAGE stacks are lost after 2 second(s) without performing a RAGE Attack. RAGE stacks do not expire during Hulk's or his Opponent's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: RAGE Attacks
content: Deal a burst of [1,598.55] Physical Damage for each RAGE stack.
Deal a burst of [1,862.87] Direct Damage to Hulk for each RAGE stack except when using the Medium 1 Attack. Hulk cannot be knocked out by this ability.

If the Recoil Mastery is active, the Recoil Damage is disabled and deals a burst of [3,725.74] Direct Damage to Hulk instead, plus an equal amount for each Rank. Hulk cannot be knocked out by this ability.

abilitySections.title: Persistent Gamma Radiation
content: Gamma Radiation's maximum strength is equal to 100% of Hulk's Max Health, and scales with boosts and buffs.
20% of all Damage dealt to Hulk when struck is stored as Gamma Radiation.
60% of all damage dealt to Hulk while afflicted with a Degeneration Effect is stored as Gamma Radiation.
100% of all self-inflicted Damage is stored as Gamma Radiation.

abilitySections.title: Immortality
content: When receiving damage that would knock out Hulk while Gamma Radiation is at or above 15%, consume 15% and gain an Immortality Passive, preventing death and becoming Unblockable for 8 second(s). This ability has a 50 second cooldown.
While active, any damage prevented by Immortality consumes an equal amount of Gamma Radiation instead. This does not apply to self-inflicted Damage.
When Immortality expires, consume all Gamma Radiation. Become Invulnerable and gain a Regeneration Passive, recovering [18,628.7] Health plus all Gamma Radiation as Health over 1 second(s).

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: The first hit refreshes the RAGE timer and doubles the amount of RAGE stacks.
The last hit gains [4,262.8] Attack Rating for each RAGE stack.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The last hit of this attack has a 60% chance to inflict a Stun Debuff, lasting 1.75 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The last hit of this attack has a 100% chance to inflict a Stun Debuff, lasting 3 seconds.
Inflict a Suppression Debuff for each RAGE stack, reducing Combat Power Rate by 5% for 15 second(s). Max 14 stack(s).

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Add a flat 15% strength to Gamma Radiation.
Inflict a Petrify Debuff of 25% Potency for 20 second(s).
